description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'FeaturedItemsController' responsible for managing featured product items in an e-commerce application's admin interface. It provides endpoints for listing, paginating, adding, and removing featured products, including interactions with service classes and handling HTTP requests/responses.

classes.name: FeaturedItemsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing CRUD operations for featured product items in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayFeaturedItems
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of featured items, sets menu and loads categories.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST request to paginate and retrieve featured products, returning JSON data.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a product to the featured items list.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a product from the featured items list.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context for the admin UI.
